description: Real CLI and EVM adapter recover an accepted submission after response loss and broker restart, without another approval or broadcast.
Unreadable historical record stays non-replayable across broker restart while same-account and different-account writes are admitted. Includes public CLI exchange-mock and owned-Anvil evidence.
Real CLI synthetic cancellation; no submission or approval on observation, and unrelated accounts continue. Native approval rendering runs separately in the security/release validation job.
Concurrent real CLI requests race one ID and distinct same-account/different-account writes while an accepted provider response is stalled; exact nonces and submission counts are asserted.

Synthetic authorized dismissal boundary plus real CLI open/status checks preserve original identity and non-replayability; unrelated wallets continue. Native human approval is separate. Includes public CLI exchange-mock and owned-Anvil evidence.

Provider accepts one transaction then loses its response; real CLI polls original identity without duplicate approval or dispatch while same/different-wallet probes proceed. Includes public CLI exchange-mock and owned-Anvil evidence.
Delayed EVM confirmation exposes in-progress and next-check cadence, then converges by polling; same/different-account probes proceed. Includes public CLI exchange-mock and owned-Anvil evidence.

A missing informational valuation does not block a native transfer, while an unavailable required Uniswap quote fails before approval or submission. Includes public CLI exchange-mock and owned-Anvil evidence.

A similar unconfirmed transfer is shown in the financial approval review and does not block either same-account or different-account activity. Includes public CLI exchange-mock and owned-Anvil evidence.
A verified native transfer with missing receipt fee reports executed with partial accounting and exact transfer, without inventing a cost. Includes public CLI exchange-mock and owned-Anvil evidence.
The real CLI advances guarded owned-fork CCTP stages under refreshed native fees, asks once for increased remainder authority, and admits same-wallet and distinct-wallet probes.

Real CLI against a controlled CCTP provider spends independently available destination funds while the original source transfer remains in transit, with a separate source transfer probe. Includes independent destination funds through an exchange withdrawal.
A genuine schema-25 Hyperliquid SOL favorable sell is observed through the CLI with its original approval and submission, while independent wallet probes proceed.

Schema-25 identity, plan, grant, resolution, bridge, and over-limit run fixtures migrate and remain observable while independent writes proceed; finite config and interrupted migrations are verified. Protected runtime-update interruption fixtures run separately in the lifecycle/release validation job.
A correlated UniswapX fill below the approved minimum remains executed with discrepancy; same and different wallets continue.
An owned Anvil transaction really reverts after admission, burns gas, and reports retry requiring new approval while other accounts proceed.

An unconfirmed operation remains observable and does not replay or block same- and different-account writes; separate synthetic configuration and update fixtures exercise maintenance with pending history. Includes public CLI exchange-mock and owned-Anvil evidence.
Development-only Yolo gate admits one action before disable, rejects another before admission, and keeps the admitted identity observable; help discloses no personal limits.

Real CLI processes disconnect at preparation, before admission, after admitted broadcast and after confirmation; restarted brokers recover the original facts without duplicate writes. Includes public CLI exchange-mock and owned-Anvil evidence.
Owned Anvil drops an original transaction and finalizes a different transaction at its nonce; proof permits a newly approved retry and unrelated wallets remain usable.
Owned offline Surfpool advances an original signed Solana blockhash past expiry; correlated full local block history proves absence, with independent wallet probes.

Real CLI on owned Anvil refreshes an expired native fee estimate within original approval and rejects a higher fee above the approved ceiling; both cases admit independent transfers on the same and another wallet.

Real CLI quote-expiry refresh on owned Anvil and Kraken: valid native authority permits refreshed candidates, fees above the original ceiling fail before dispatch, and same/different protected accounts remain usable.
